# neo4j-cli

> A super CLI for Neo4j. Team up with your agents to build graph apps from your terminal.

neo4j-cli is an open-source command-line tool for managing Neo4j resources, executing Cypher queries via the Bolt protocol, and integrating with AI agent frameworks (Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Copilot, Gemini CLI, Cline, Codex, Pi, OpenCode, Junie).

## Installation

```bash
pipx install neo4j-cli==0.1.0a10
```

or via npm:

```bash
npm install -g @neo4j-labs/cli@alpha
```

## Command surface

- `neo4j-cli credential aura-client add` — store Aura Console API credentials (client ID + secret)
- `neo4j-cli credential dbms add` — store Neo4j Bolt connection profiles for reuse via `--credential`
- `neo4j-cli credential embed add` — store embedding-provider credentials (openai, ollama, huggingface)
- `neo4j-cli aura instance list` — list Aura instances (table or JSON)
- `neo4j-cli aura instance create` — provision a new Aura instance (`--name` optional; auto-generates `InstanceNN` if omitted)
- `neo4j-cli aura instance get <id>` — get instance details
- `neo4j-cli query <cypher>` — run Cypher against any Neo4j via the Bolt protocol
- `neo4j-cli query :schema` — introspect node labels, rel types, properties
- `neo4j-cli query :embed [text]` — compute an embedding vector standalone (no Bolt connection)
- `neo4j-cli query --param NAME:embed=<text>` — bind an inline-embedded vector parameter
- `neo4j-cli query 'CREATE ...' --rw` — write operations require `--rw`
- `neo4j-cli skill install` — install the agent skill bundle into your AI assistant
- `neo4j-cli skill list` — list supported agents and per-agent install state
- `neo4j-cli skill check` — verify installed bundles for version drift
- `neo4j-cli skill print` — preview the embedded SKILL.md before installing
- `neo4j-cli skill remove` — remove an installed bundle (idempotent)
- `neo4j-cli update` — self-update the binary to the latest GitHub release (`--check` to report only, `--pre-releases` for alpha/beta/rc, `--version <tag>` to pin)

## Connection

Connection precedence: flag → environment variable → `.env` file → stored default.

Default URI: `neo4j://localhost:7687`, username: `neo4j`, database: `neo4j`.

`http://` and `https://` URIs are auto-rewritten to `neo4j://<host>:7687` and `neo4j+s://<host>:7687` respectively (path/query stripped). For self-signed certs use `neo4j+ssc://`.

## Output formats

All read commands support `--format json|table` (`-f` shorthand). Default is `table` on a TTY, `json` when piped.

JSON envelope: `{"columns": [...], "rows": [{"<col>": <value>, ...}, ...], "truncated": false, "arrays_truncated": 0}` — `rows` are column-keyed objects; `arrays_truncated` is the count of cell arrays elided by `--truncate-arrays-over`.

## Agent skills

neo4j-cli ships with a built-in agent skill bundle that teaches AI assistants (Claude Code, Cursor, etc.) how to drive the CLI. Install with:

```bash
neo4j-cli skill install --rw
```

`--rw` is required for any command that mutates state (Aura API, local config, credentials, skills, write Cypher). Read-only commands (`skill list`, `skill check`, `skill print`, `query <read>`, `aura instance list`) do not need it.

Additional Neo4j skills for AI agents: https://github.com/neo4j-contrib/neo4j-skills
